decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost and ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thought-Knot Seer and counterspells to control the game. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the necessary mana base and cast game-ending threats that are difficult for opponents to deal with. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its powerful creatures and mana advantage, making it a formidable force in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on controlling the game early with disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will, while also maintaining card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The key strategy is to tempo out opponents by using efficient removal like Fatal Push and countering key spells. Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf provide powerful threats that can quickly close out the game. The land base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and disrupt opponents' lands with cards like Wasteland.

This deck focuses on creating a strong enchantress engine to draw cards and generate mana while controlling the board with enchantments. By combining powerful enchantresses like Argothian Enchantress and Sythis, Harvest's Hand with enchantment-based ramp like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, the deck can quickly assemble a combo win condition such as Helm of Obedience or United Battlefront. The deck also includes disruption elements like Rest in Peace and On Thin Ice to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own key pieces.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources by using various tools like Sphere of Resistance and Crop Rotation to disrupt their game plan. The key strategy revolves around utilizing lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create powerful token creatures while also maintaining control with cards like Maze of Ith and Wasteland. By slowing down the opponent's plays and generating value from lands like Urza's Saga and Life from the Loam, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory in the late game.

The main focus of this Legacy Merfolk aggro deck is to establish a strong board presence early on with powerful lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and disruptive creatures like Tide Shaper. The inclusion of True-Name Nemesis provides a difficult to deal with threat, while Aether Vial allows for cheating creatures into play at instant speed. Wasteland provides additional disruption to slow down the opponent, while Sink into Stupor can help control the opponent's hand.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Mystic Forge to generate card advantage and manipulate the top of the library in order to assemble powerful combos quickly and efficiently. The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with artifacts like Grim Monolith and Urza's Tower, while utilizing cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Karn, the Great Creator to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Defense Grid and Pithing Needle also helps protect key combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. This deck aims to quickly outpace opponents and overwhelm them with powerful synergies.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo of Show and Tell to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play. The deck includes a mix of counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo, along with card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find key pieces. Additionally, there are cards like Omniscience and Profane Tutor to further support the combo strategy. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overpower the opponent with big threats.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb in order to cast big threat cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using Show and Tell. The deck also includes various counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces and disruption spells like Flusterstorm to control the game. The deck is designed to quickly put powerful threats on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond effectively.

This deck revolves around the synergy between Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill your opponent's entire deck in one turn. It also utilizes Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to consistently find and recur combo pieces. The deck includes various artifacts to generate mana and draw cards, as well as counter spells to protect the combo. Urza's Saga is utilized to tutor for artifacts, creating additional value. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan to win the game in a decisive manner.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bringing them back onto the battlefield using various reanimation spells. By using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting to set up the graveyard and spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring creatures back, the deck can bring out powerful threats like Griselbrand and Ashen Rider early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Thoughtseize and Unmask to protect its game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield without paying their mana costs. The deck also includes a lot of card draw and protection spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to help set up the combo and protect it once it's in play. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with giant creatures and powerful effects while controlling the game through its card advantage and disruption spells.

The deck revolves around cheating big creatures into play quickly using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. The key strategy is to overpower the opponent with powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. With a combination of card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own combo to quickly close out the game.

The deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures onto the battlefield by utilizing cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Stock Up. It includes heavy control elements with Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and Thoughtseize to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to cheat out high-cost creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with their power and abilities. It also includes resources like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate the combo.

The main concept of this Legacy Control - Stiflenought deck is to utilize powerful creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal like Force of Will, Stifle, and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to control the game through card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder, while also utilizing efficient threats like Curie, Emergent Intelligence and Abhorrent Oculus. The deck also includes land disruption with Wasteland and mana fixing with fetch lands. The goal is to maintain control over the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying powerful threats to win the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal, and disruption while utilizing the synergy between Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to quickly set up a powerful threat. The inclusion of Curie, Emergent Intelligence and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student adds card advantage and incremental value to the control strategy. The deck aims to efficiently answer threats and disrupt opposing game plans using a mix of permission spells, removal, and proactive threats, ultimately aiming to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck focuses on using powerful reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game. It also utilizes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect its combo pieces and control the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck runs a variety of counter spells like Force of Will to protect its own creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is built to support the deck's multi-color requirements and includes a strong land destruction package with Wasteland.

The main objective of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells while disrupting their game plan with countermagic and land destruction. Using cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply early pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. By combining efficient creatures with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, the deck seeks to control the tempo of the game and prevent the opponent from mounting a successful defense.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to control the opponent's actions through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Counterspell, and Daze, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. Additionally, the deck includes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragonologist to apply pressure and close out the game. The land base is tuned for consistency and mana fixing, allowing the deck to smoothly execute its control game plan.

The main concept of this UWx Control Legacy deck is to control the board through removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Supreme Verdict, as well as disruptive cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Back to Basics. The deck focuses on card advantage and flexibility with cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Snapcaster Mage. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card draw and utility, while Staff of the Storyteller offers protection against opposing spells. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck while also including utility lands like Mystic Sanctuary.
